headline: US voters approve local restrictions on data centers
summary: Voters in local US elections approved restrictions on data centers, exposing resistance to the expansion of digital infrastructure amid concerns over energy and resource consumption.
why: Data centers require massive electrical power and water resources, making local zoning and regulatory approvals critical for tech infrastructure growth.

impacts.name: Technology Infrastructure
impacts.why: Voter-approved restrictions on data centers limit the expansion of digital infrastructure.
